description: Hand-maintained citation mappings for records the automatic resolver cannot resolve from the 2024 source publication alone. scripts/build-citation-model.mjs reads this file and never writes to it. Every mapped entry records the evidence that justified it; entries without evidence are not mappings, they are guesses, and must not be added.

offense-0953.rationale: As with offense-0952: 'Section 9-315.02' with no chapter or act, under the Uniform Commercial Code chapter heading. 810 ILCS 5/9-315.02 carries a section title identical to this record's description.

offense-0515.rationale: 720 ILCS 620 (Flag Desecration Act) was repealed in its entirety by P.A. 97-1108, so section 1 no longer exists and ILGA serves no text for it. Whether any current provision covers this conduct is a legal question, not a citation-format one, so no successor is asserted here.

offense-0949.rationale: 750 ILCS 30 is the Illinois Domestic Violence Act of 1982, superseded by the Illinois Domestic Violence Act of 1986 (750 ILCS 60), so section 2-12 is no longer served. 720 ILCS 5/12-3.4 ("Violation of an order of protection") is the obvious candidate and its heading matches this description, but identifying the successor to a repealed statute is a substantive legal determination rather than a citation correction, so it is left for a reviewer.

research.candidateHeading: Sec. 12-3.4. Violation of an order of protection.
